title: Disturbance Rejection Control of a Mass-Spring-Damper System
expert_review: A solid frequency-domain controller design problem emphasizing disturbance rejection and classical stability margins.
learning_objectives: Model mechanical systems with external disturbances
Design integral controllers for disturbance rejection
Use Bode plots to assess stability margins
